reference: H. Okamoto, J. Phase Equilibria Diffusion, 29(2), 204 (2008) doi:10.1007/s11669-008-9267-2; compiled in H. Okamoto, Desk Handbook: Phase Diagrams for Binary Alloys, 2nd ed., ASM International, Materials Park, OH (2010), p. 371
comment: evidence_class=assessed_phase_diagram (expert-drawn diagram, not experimental, not CALPHAD); ORCHID assessed-phase-assemblages v1.0.0, dense field grid (method 1.0.0), diagram CU-ZR-p371; regular interior (T, x) grid inside every named field, at least 0.006 (frame-normalised) from every drawn line; single-phase: the phase at the point composition; two-phase: phases present, compositions unknown (null) with __HYPERPLANE__ at the point's overall composition. Points of one diagram are not independent: orchid.field_weight_share gives each point's share of one observation per field. Phase names mapped to CuZr-94Zen-LB.tdb through the ORCHID phase registry (points whose phases are not all in that TDB are left out).

orchid_uncertainty_budget.sigma_rule: max(sqrt(max(printed, reading, method)^2 + composition^2 + conversion^2), scatter); boundary margin reported, not combined
